_doc: Anti-drift compass for the SERVICE-HAILING arc (SERVICE_HAILING_ROADMAP.md). Ian 2026-07-29: 'we to do 100% overall in the roadmap' - the phase table (P0-P9) is ONE axis; overall means EVERY axis §3 names. tools/service_hailing_scoreboard.py reads this and emits MEASURED % over three boards: JOURNEYS (D-J x phases, with the §3 coverage attributes D-P/D-S/D-M/D-Geo/D-G as the W-gate), UFAI SURFACES (§3b, per-surface rubric), and CLASSES (§2 C1-C11, each ending in its named gate). A green phase table never ends the arc (feedback_seed_resolved_is_not_roadmap_done + the one-metric-masks-an-axis rule). | EXPANDED 2026-07-29 (Ian: 'have you checked the entire contents... expand the needed deepwalk journeys'): a full re-read of §1c/§3d/§5/P5-P7 found NINE capabilities the §3 D-J line never enumerated - the live MAP (D5), Web Push (G3), AI triage (P7), the consumer segment's own hail/track/review (D-G), idle AREA presence (D8), and three §1c booster engines (community liquidity, public-feed showcase, dayplanner auto-landing). Denominator 24 -> 33. The % DROPS on purpose: the expansion doctrine grows both denominators rather than scoring 100% over a short one.

_phases_def.G: ground - the journey's steps + surfaces + code paths are mapped
_phases_def.W: walk - live end-to-end on the REAL page. DERIVED, never asserted: requires >=2 personas AND >=2 states (the §3 D-P/D-S axes). One-persona/one-state is the shallowness this board exists to kill
_phases_def.O: observe - friction/behaviour recorded with evidence (a screenshot, a DB row, a console read)
_phases_def.H: harvest - a real observed friction was turned into a fix/dim, or the journey is marked clean
_phases_def.R: resolve - shipped AND verified (gate probe, live re-walk, or DB assertion)

_coverage_rule: W is computed from walked.personas/walked.states, never hand-set: >=2 personas AND >=2 states => done; exactly 1 of either => partial; none => todo. This is why a journey I drove live as ONE persona cannot read 100%.
_ufai_rule: A surface's UFAI row is done only when family_rubric_sweep.mjs has MEASURED it (not judged/na) on the WORKED state and its overall >= the family floor (90), with 0 page errors.

S2-pwa-offline.note: DECIDED and ENFORCED: a hail is NOT queued offline.
